title: Chapter 1473
text:
The three of them digested it for a while before they finally understood the information that Han Xiao had revealed.

Louis was a little hesitant.

"Black Star, you're not tricking us, are you …"

"Unfortunately, not this time." Han Xiao shrugged.

Marbruce had a strange expression as he pondered and said, "In other words, we're all people who have died and been reborn several times. It's equivalent to being trapped in a sealed secondary dimension, and our final goal is to break through this secondary dimension and return to the main universe?"

"Hmm, although the difference is quite big, you can understand it that way." Han Xiao blinked.

"What you mean is that everything that our civilization has experienced from nothing is destined to happen. It has already happened several times, and it was' personally 'created by us in the past?"

"That's more or less it." Han Xiao nodded.

"Wait for me to calm down …"

The Ethereal Pope pressed his forehead and felt his blood pressure soaring.

Suddenly being hit by so much information, the three of them felt that their worldview had been shattered. In front of such a situation, they realized that all the political and military issues they usually considered were insignificant.

"So, we're that powerful …"

Marbruce muttered with shock still on his face.

Han Xiao mercilessly interrupted his imagination. "It's not you guys who are powerful, but the ultimate three Universal Civilizations. Compared to your peak 'selves' in the past, you guys are just three younger brothers. Don't flatter the current three Universal Civilizations. Without me, you guys would still know nothing."

"…"

The three of them felt a little hurt.

Although this is the truth, can't you let us indulge in our fantasies for a while?

However, no matter what, after suddenly learning these secrets, the three of them still had an inexplicable mentality, and they felt that their backs were straighter.

"Black Star, you really gave us a shock …" Marbruce smiled bitterly. "My mind is in a mess now. I don't know what to do."

Han Xiao raised his brows and joked, "Didn't you say you've seen a lot? Have you seen this before?"

"Ahem, I think we should talk about how to break the seal of the dark side universe and return to the real universe …"

The Ethereal Hierarch's face darkened. He quickly changed the topic, not wanting to admit that he had been careless.

However, Han Xiao did not answer directly. He changed the topic and said slowly,

"I know that you guys still have some doubts in your hearts and think that I'm making this up. When you enter the Sanctum and confirm that the information I've provided is correct, we'll talk about what to do next … By the way, let me remind you that you need permission to read the messages of the Iterations in the Sanctum. The first time you enter, you can only know the basic situation at most, which is information about the Iterations, the Great Reboot, and so on. As for information about the dark side Iterations and the cycle restarting, you won't be able to see them for the time being. I only found out about these things after I fully unlocked my permission."

"Oh, so that's how it is …"

The three of them had not witnessed the effects of the Sanctum with their own eyes, so they could only listen obediently to Han Xiao's explanation. However, they mostly believed him because there was no need for Black Star to lie to them about something that could be easily verified.

However, the three of them still felt an itch in their hearts. This feeling was like watching a suspense movie. They had only watched the beginning, and Black Star knew all the details but did not tell them who the murderer was. This made them very curious.

However, the three of them still had concerns and did not dare to completely believe what Han Xiao said. They would only be at ease after entering the Sanctum and taking a look.

"I'll send you the way to enter the Sanctum later. I'll also synthesize three Sanctum keys for you guys. You guys can go in yourselves, lest you say that I did something."

Han Xiao waved his hand and said casually.

Only he could quickly generate the Sanctum keys. Even the three Universal Civilizations, who were rich in resources, needed time to collect materials. Therefore, without his help, the three Universal Civilizations would not be able to enter and leave the Sanctum frequently. This was also why he had the confidence to control the Sanctum, so he did not mind letting the three Universal Civilizations enter the Sanctum.

"That's the best."

The three of them hurriedly nodded like obedient children.

"Alright, then you guys digest the truth of the universe Iterations first. I won't disturb you guys anymore. I'll send you the information later."

Han Xiao nodded and hung up.

The remote projection disappeared, and Marbruce and the other two looked at each other with different expressions.

"I didn't expect Black Star to bring such information … If what he said is true, then we'll have to replan our future development."

"That's right. If the situation is true, then there's no point in us developing peacefully here. We have to break through fate and fulfill the wishes of our previous lives to enter the so-called real universe."

"Let's not talk about this for now. Let's start from the beginning …"

The three of them gathered their heads together and discussed intensely.

…

Supers Holy Land, Leader's Office.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he returned to his room. Complicated emotions appeared in his eyes.

He had pretended to be confident in front of the three Universal Civilizations, but in fact, when he found out the truth from the Sanctum, he was also shocked, but it also solved his doubts for many years.

In fact, Han Xiao still had many secret guesses that he had not told the three Universal Civilizations' Rulers earlier. For example, the existence of the interface. In his opinion, there were three possibilities.

Firstly, the interface was a special product formed when the True State of the Iterated Universe was transformed into the Information State of the Dark Side Universe. It was like a high-dimensional object that had a special advantage when it descended to a low-dimensional world. It was like a piece of paper that humans could see through at a glance, or it was a part of the information that low-dimensional worlds could not express.

The second possibility was a product of information mutation.

The third guess was that the three Universal Civilizations of the second dark side Iteration projected the 'information collection' of the dark side universe into the real universe and pulled the True State through 'logging in'. The interface was a necessary medium to complete this step. It could be considered a special 'tractor' or 'recorder', so it might have been specially created by the three Universal Civilizations in the past to ensure that the True State remained in the dark side universe for a long time.

However, no matter which one it was, the interface was unique to the dark side universe and could not enter the real universe. The evidence that Han Xiao deduced this was that the interface would disappear when he entered the Sanctum … Because the Sanctum did not only exist in the dark side universe, the interface lost its effect there.

Han Xiao also had some guesses about his' special 'interface.

In his opinion, this was either a life guarantee that the three Universal Civilizations of the third dark side Iteration deliberately created for the 'information individual' who had completely entered the dark side universe in order to build a stable interference bridge, ensuring that he could live 'stably' in the dark side universe and reduce the chances of him dying due to various accidents, or it was the result of the information mutation of the normal interface after the dark side Iteration.

According to the various performances of the interface, Han Xiaoxin was more inclined to the former. When the interface triggered a mission, it would often reveal more information in the mission introduction. Because the development trajectory of the dark side universe was almost fixed, it was completely possible for the three Universal Civilizations of the third dark side Iteration to improve the interface to such a 'prophet' function … Of course, it did not rule out the possibility that their own interface had the hidden principle of monitoring the entire dark side universe.

In addition, when the players went online (True State intervention), he could only enter the player forums through the interface and spy on the information exchange of a group of 'True States'. During the version update period, the forums were also frozen for him. From this point of view, the special interface on his body was indeed an important medium and channel to communicate with the True States.

This reminded Han Xiao of the two information threads he saw on the interface when he used the Information Form Obliteration Vision. One was connected to him, while the other extended infinitely. Now that he thought about it, this end represented the connection of the entire dark side universe … This seemed to support this idea.

On the other hand, Han Xiao also speculated on the principle of the flow of time in the version update … In the mainstream scientific theory of the Galaxy, time was relative and not absolute. From this point of view, and based on the contents of the Sanctum message board, he felt that the time of the dark side universe and the real universe had nothing to do with each other. There was only a difference in relative speed.

The real universe was the foundation of the third Iteration, and the dark side universe had to be attached to it. However, the relative time flow of the dark side universe was faster, and the two sides did not affect each other. However, when the players went online and caused the dark side universe and the real universe to be entangled, the time flow of both sides would be embedded. The time of the dark side universe and the real universe would flow at a stable ratio, which was one to six … The reason behind this was that the real universe was still in the dominant position, and the players whose 'foundation' existed in the real universe would not be affected in the reverse direction.

When the True States of the players who temporarily 'logged in' disappeared, the degree of information interference plummeted. Thus, the time flow of the dark side universe was disconnected from the real universe … The form of this conjecture was that the version update only took one or two days for the players, but many years had passed in the Galaxy World. Han Xiao felt that this possibility was not small.

He even suspected that starting from the second dark side Iteration, the frequent information mutation of the dark side universe was very likely caused by the introduction of the True State in the third dark side Iteration … If the real universe and the Sanctums were regarded as higher dimensional existences, then the projection would be distorted and 'distortion' would occur, causing the information materialization device of the third dark side Iteration to become the World Tree, and the control valve of the fourth dark side Iteration to become the Pivotal Snake.

"Other than this reason, perhaps the dark side universe is the same as the Celestial Star Alliance dimension. Only an external information carrier can greatly change the development trajectory, bring new variables, and add accidents … Even if the dark side universe is not a rigid cycle, it might still need such a variable."

Han Xiao's eyes changed.

Although many of these theories were guesses that he had deduced based on the truth revealed by the Sanctums, he felt that the possibility was very high.

"Even if this is a long relay that crosses Iterations, every civilization definitely wants to be the last one. As long as there's a glimmer of hope, every civilization wants to continue. No one wants to go extinct. It's understandable for the three Universal Civilizations to do so, but …"

Han Xiao shook his head with complicated feelings.

If all his deductions were correct, then he was the hope of the entire dark side universe …

However, to him, this was a multiple-choice question.
